title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Int.add_mul
statement: The proposition declared as `Int.add_mul` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ (a b c : ℤ), (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c
formal.kernel_statement: theorem Int.add_mul : ((x0 : Int) -> ((x1 : Int) -> ((x2 : Int) -> Eq.{1} Int (Int.mul (Int.add x0 x1) x2) (Int.add (Int.mul x0 x2) (Int.mul x1 x2)))))
